title: University of Layyah vision, mission and goals
content: Vision: To be the university of choice in transforming the region into a hub of commercialization by empowering youth through cutting-edge research and inclusive development. Mission: The University of Layyah will inspire, educate and develop its students to lead by example in nation-building, achieve excellence in innovative learning and address the needs of all segments of life and beyond. Goals: (1) Character building of the students to impart tolerance and to develop the habit of doing innovative work. (2) Collaboration with national and international experts and institutes for capacity building of faculty and students. (3) Providing a conducive environment for student's learning to develop leadership qualities. (4) Affordable fee structure to encourage the people of the area to achieve their goals.
